Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in intervieIIT Delhi Manager Recruitment 2026 - w for IIT Delhi Manager Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment is Manager. This is a contractual position announced via a walk-in interview drive.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Manager post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Manager post in the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech. in Materials Engineering with 2 years of relevant experience in Metal Additive Manufacturing or a Ph.D. to be eligible for the Manager position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Manager position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Manager position ranges from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 per month, with incremental steps mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Manager post at IIT Delhi is scheduled for 27 August 2026. Candidates should arrive on time.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IIT Delhi Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this IIT Delhi Manager recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview venue.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Manager post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Manager post will include a Walk-in Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the IIT Delhi located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110016. The specific venue for the walk-in interview will be detailed in the official notification.
